title: Design System: Oren Segal Portfolio — Utility Cutaway

body.purpose: All prose: About, project descriptions, Contact intro, flight-log copy.

label.purpose: Project-detail sub-headers (Problem/Decisions/Outcome/Key features/Impact/Tech stack) only. Unchanged this session.

meta-mono.purpose: JetBrains Mono, confined to three machine-sourced-fact sites: DepthTag label (10px, tracking-widest/0.1em, the one site with extra tracking), Hero verified-count line, and ProjectRow id/date toggle (both normal tracking). Never prose or headings; color (ink-faint vs accent) tracks interaction state independently of the mono choice.

motion.name: utility-line-reveal
motion.purpose: In-place tactile expansion of a ProjectRow's flight-log/key-features detail. Not an accordion library.

motion.name: chevron-rotate
motion.purpose: ProjectRow toggle chevron, paired with the reveal above. Same curve as rise and the reveal — one easing for all transform/size motion in the system.

components.name: Depth Tag
components.description: Rotated -90deg, absolutely positioned, aria-hidden mono label naming a section's depth in the cutaway (surface/shallow utility/deepest/resurfacing). Not a kicker: sits outside the text column in the spine's own margin, no heading-pairing semantics, hidden from assistive tech.
components.css: .ds-depth-tag { position: absolute; left: -9px; top: 0; transform-origin: top left; transform: rotate(-90deg); white-space: nowrap; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #7a7d7f; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Status Dot
components.description: 8x8 SVG static data indicator, not a hover/active state signal. Filled accent circle = has a full build log on file; outlined ink-faint circle = summary only. Used at rest in Hero (verified-count line) and in each ProjectRow toggle.
components.html: <svg width="8" height="8" viewBox="0 0 8 8"><circle cx="4" cy="4" r="4" fill="#8fd6a8"/></svg>
components.css: /* filled: fill #8fd6a8, r=4. outlined: fill none, stroke #7a7d7f, stroke-width 1.25, r=3.25 */

components.name: Utility Line (Project Row)
components.description: Signature interactive pattern replacing a card: title with trailing arrow, mono id/date toggle with StatusDot and chevron (goes accent while expanded), horizontal connector tick joining the row to the section spine (bg-line at rest, bg-accent expanded), and a grid-template-rows reveal of real Problem/Decisions/Outcome or Key Features/Impact copy.
components.html: Project Title
components.css: .ds-utility-line { position: relative; border-bottom: 1px solid #232527; padding: 32px 0; } .ds-connector-tick { position: absolute; left: -20px; top: 15px; height: 1px; width: 20px; background: #232527; transition: background-color 0.3s; } .ds-utility-line.expanded .ds-connector-tick { background: #8fd6a8; } .ds-utility-line-toggle { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; color: #7a7d7f; } .ds-utility-line.expanded .ds-utility-line-toggle { color: #8fd6a8; } .ds-utility-line-detail { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 0fr; transition: grid-template-rows 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-utility-line.expanded .ds-utility-line-detail { grid-template-rows: 1fr; }

components.name: Inline Text Link
components.description: In-sentence link with a dim underline at rest that brightens on hover — Hero's GitHub-percentage link, project 'source' links.
components.html: 42% of it open source, verifiable on GitHub
components.css: .ds-link-inline { color: #f2f1ea; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #4b7a5d; text-underline-offset: 4px; transition: color 0.15s, text-decoration-color 0.15s; } .ds-link-inline:hover, .ds-link-inline:focus-visible { text-decoration-color: #8fd6a8; } .ds-link-inline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8fd6a8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Action Link
components.description: Standalone call-to-action link with a trailing arrow icon that nudges on hover — 'See the work'.
components.html: See the work
components.css: .ds-link-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #f2f1ea; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-link-action-icon { transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-link-action:hover .ds-link-action-icon { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-link-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8fd6a8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Top navigation — dim by default, brightens on hover, no underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color: #9a9d9f; font-size: 14px; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #f2f1ea; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8fd6a8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Contact Channel Row
components.description: Icon + label link row in Contact, py-4 (16px) interval; icon and text transition to accent together as one hover target (interaction-state accent, not the utility-line active state).
components.html: orenssegal@gmail.com
components.css: .ds-channel-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #232527; padding: 16px 0; } .ds-channel-row:first-child { padding-top: 0; } .ds-channel-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; } .ds-channel-icon { color: #7a7d7f; transition: color 0.15s; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-channel-label { color: #f2f1ea; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-channel-row:hover .ds-channel-icon, .ds-channel-row:hover .ds-channel-label { color: #8fd6a8; }

components.name: Section Spine
components.description: The cutaway metaphor's core structural device: every full-width section wraps its content in a left-bordered spine carrying a DepthTag. Replaces the prior system's plain section divider as the section-level pattern.
components.css: .ds-section { border-top: 1px solid #232527; padding: 96px 16px; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-section { padding-left: 24px; padding-right: 24px; } } .ds-spine { position: relative; max-width: 768px; margin: 0 auto; border-left: 1px solid #232527; padding-left: 20px; }

components.name: Detail Sub-header Label
components.description: Uppercase, tracked sub-header scoped to the project-detail page only (Problem/Decisions/Outcome/Key features/Impact/Tech stack) — not a general kicker. Unchanged this session.
components.css: .ds-detail-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #7a7d7f; }

narrative.northStar: Utility Cutaway — the page is a literal underground utility cross-section; what a visitor sees on the surface sits on real strata of infrastructure work beneath it
narrative.overview: This build supersedes the prior 'no governing metaphor' plain system and the earlier, never-shipped 'Night Flight-Deck' instrument-panel direction. The current shipped system stages the page as a literal underground utility cross-section: the near-black ground (#0a0b0c) is depth. Every major section — Hero, Work, About, Contact — is a vertical cutaway spine (border-l border-line pl-5), each carrying a rotated depth label naming how far down it sits: 'surface' (Hero), 'shallow utility' (Work), 'deepest' (About), 'resurfacing' (Contact). Inside Work, each project is a utility line crossing the spine via a horizontal connector tick; clicking a project's toggle expands it in place with a tactile grid-height reveal, showing real Problem/Decisions/Outcome or Key Features/Impact copy. Accent green marks exactly three things: interaction state, the active/expanded utility line, and the filled status dot as a binary data affirmative — it never fills a background or colors a heading. No fabricated metrics anywhere: every number and date is sourced at build time from the live GitHub API, all-or-nothing.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground (#0a0b0c) read as literal depth — four sections render as a border-l cutaway spine with a rotated -90deg depth label

Two type families with strict division of labor: Space Grotesk for every heading/sentence; JetBrains Mono confined to three machine-sourced-fact sites (depth tags, Hero verified line, project id/date toggle) at 10-12px, never prose or headings
Accent green (#8fd6a8) has exactly three jobs: interaction state, the expanded project row's active marking, and the filled StatusDot as a static binary data signal
Each project is a utility line: a horizontal connector tick (w-5, matching the spine's pl-5 gutter exactly) that goes accent when its row is expanded
Expansion is a tactile grid-template-rows reveal (0fr -> 1fr, 500ms), not an accordion library
One motion curve (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) drives Hero's entrance, the row reveal, and the chevron rotation

rules.name: The Accent-as-Signal Rule
rules.body: Accent green is spent on exactly three things: interaction (hover/focus/selection), the one active utility line's marking (tick, chevron, toggle text while expanded), and the filled status dot as a binary data affirmative. It is never a background fill, never a static heading color, and there is no second accent hue. A resting filled StatusDot is accent by design (data, not decoration) — do not 'fix' it to ink-faint.

rules.name: The Scoped Mono Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono renders exactly three things: the depth-tag label, the Hero verified-count timestamp line, and each project's id/date toggle. All three are small (10-12px), machine-sourced facts. Mono never appears in a heading, in prose, or at a larger size. The ProjectRow toggle's mono text still switches ink-faint to accent with expansion state — mono marks content type, color marks state; the two are independent.

rules.name: The One Rendered Surface Rule
rules.body: Exactly one background tone is painted on the page (panel, #0a0b0c). Depth is expressed by hairline dividers and the cutaway-spine device (border-l spines plus rotated depth labels), never by a second background fill, a shadow, or a blur.

dos: Do confine mono (JetBrains Mono) to the three scoped sites — depth tags, Hero's verified line, project id/date toggles — always small and always a machine-sourced fact. Do not use mono for a heading or a sentence of prose.
Do use border-l border-line pl-5 plus a DepthTag for any new full-width section that should read as part of the cutaway.
Do spend accent green only on the three named jobs (interaction, active utility line, filled status dot).
Do keep the connector-tick width (w-5) matched to the spine gutter (pl-5) if adding new lines crossing a spine.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: app/globals.css collapses all animation/transition durations to near-zero.
donts: Don't use a max-height or opacity-only accordion for a new in-place expansion — the system's technique is a grid-template-rows (0fr <-> 1fr) reveal, confirmed by ProjectRow's existing implementation.
Don't treat StatusDot's resting accent fill as a general license for static accent color elsewhere — it is scoped to genuine binary data indicators.
Don't widen mono past the three scoped sites, and don't let it inherit the color rule from prose.
Don't add a second background/surface tone, a shadow, a blur, or a gradient.
Don't box content in bordered cards — the structural unit is the hairline divider plus the spine/tick device for Work's utility lines.
Don't add a category filter/toggle to Work.
Don't turn DepthTag into a horizontal eyebrow/kicker pattern anywhere else on the site.
Don't treat panel.face (#121315, added to tailwind.config.ts this session) as an active token — zero usages across .tsx/.css in the shipped tree; it is leftover, not part of the system.

Don't treat lib/projects.ts's image/icon emoji fields or gradient color strings as design-system material — neither is rendered by ProjectRow or Projects.tsx; they are dead legacy data, not a glyph-icon or gradient rule.
